## Summary

What does this change do, and why?

## How it was verified

- [ ] `ruff check .` and `pytest -v` pass (backend changes)
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass (frontend changes)
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests
- [ ] Layout checked at mobile width (UI changes)

## Checklist

- [ ] Database changes include an Alembic migration that applies and reverses cleanly
- [ ] Documentation and CHANGELOG.md updated where relevant
- [ ] No secrets or personal data included
